name: awardwallet-mcp
description: Loyalty balances, elite status, expirations, account history and trips from AwardWallet, plus every AwardWallet API.
long_description: Ask about your airline miles, hotel points and credit-card rewards tracked in AwardWallet: balances, elite status, what expires soon, full transaction history, and upcoming trips. Uses the AwardWallet Business Account Access API, and optionally AwardWallet's paid Web Parsing, Email Parsing, Credit Card Bonus and Flight/Hotel Award Search APIs. Passwords and tokens needed by those APIs are typed into a one-time local page, never into the chat.

api_key.title: AwardWallet API key
api_key.description: Account Access API key from your AwardWallet Business account (Business → API settings). To try the extension without one, turn on Demo mode below.

demo_mode.title: Demo mode
demo_mode.description: Use built-in sample data instead of your AwardWallet account. Nothing is sent to AwardWallet.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Only offer tools that read data (no connection links, no paid API requests).

connection_links.title: Connection links
connection_links.description: Offer a tool that creates AwardWallet invitation links. Needs AwardWallet's approval of connection links for your business.

email_region.title: Email Parsing region
email_region.description: "us" or "eu": which AwardWallet data center the Email Parsing API uses.

web_parsing_credentials.title: Web Parsing API credentials (optional)
web_parsing_credentials.description: username:password issued by AwardWallet for the paid Web Parsing (Loyalty) API.

email_parsing_credentials.title: Email Parsing API credentials (optional)
email_parsing_credentials.description: username:password issued by AwardWallet for the paid Email Parsing API.

cc_bonus_credentials.title: Credit Card Bonus API credentials (optional)
cc_bonus_credentials.description: username:password issued by AwardWallet for the paid Credit Card Bonus API.

flight_search_credentials.title: Flight Award Search API credentials (optional)
flight_search_credentials.description: username:password issued by AwardWallet for the paid Flight Award Search API.

hotel_search_credentials.title: Hotel Award Search API credentials (optional)
hotel_search_credentials.description: username:password issued by AwardWallet for the paid Hotel Award Search API.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Which AwardWallet APIs are configured, and what the business account can see.

tools.name: list_people
tools.description: Connected AwardWallet users and business members, with their ids and sharing levels.

tools.name: list_loyalty_accounts
tools.description: Balances, elite status, expirations and update problems across loyalty accounts.

tools.name: get_loyalty_account
tools.description: One account's properties, sub-accounts and transaction history.

tools.name: get_travel_timeline
tools.description: Flights, hotels, cars and other reservations in a date window.

tools.name: get_loyalty_program
tools.description: Login fields, tracked properties and capabilities of a program.

tools.name: search_api_operations
tools.description: Find raw AwardWallet API operations and their input schemas.

tools.name: call_api_read_operation
tools.description: Run a read-only AwardWallet API operation.

tools.name: call_api_write_operation
tools.description: Run an AwardWallet API operation that changes data or costs money.

tools.name: get_secure_input_result
tools.description: Result of a request completed on the secure input page.
